scope: Screen newly surfaced downstream 2D viewer and current OpenCADStudio automation/acceptance documentation; refine only existing consumer-evidence and peer-lineage rules.

method.kind: Primary-source public repository and documentation review with local plan reconciliation
method.evidenceBoundary: Mutable project documentation establishes declared route composition and test-harness shape only. No artifact, codec behavior, output, native acceptance result, or geometry semantic result was independently reproduced.

evidence.topic: Cadze is a LibreDWG-backed 2D downstream path, not an independent DWG parser
observed: The repository describes its DXF input as using dxf-parser.
The documented DWG route invokes dwg2dxf/LibreDWG as a separate process, then reads the resulting DXF.
The public repository page identifies an MIT license and describes a WebGL2 2D viewer/editor projection.
The README does not establish a pinned release, complete object/owner graph, DWG/DXF writer round-trip contract, or ACIS/AcDs semantics.
doesNotEstablish: A second DWG parser lineage independent from LibreDWG
Complete DXF preservation or a strict entity/object inventory
3D mesh, ACIS, AcDs, B-rep, or native CAD acceptance
evidence.planUse: Only an optional downstream 2D projection observation if a named consumer question requires it. Bind DWG results to LibreDWG lineage and DXF parsing to dxf-parser; do not add a routine peer build or infer writer behavior from the UI.

evidence.topic: OpenCADStudio documents separate self-reopen and external native-audit steps
observed: save_verified is documented to write an explicit format/version, reopen through the same application, compare an entity manifest, check version and raw DXF handles, report loss, and return a hash.
The docs separately describe a Windows reference-CAD console script that opens generated DWGs and runs AUDIT without repairs, retaining per-version logs.
OpenCADStudio is already classified in the plan as ACadRust-related; the documented self-reopen route is therefore correlated with its own codec lineage.
doesNotEstablish: That either script has passed on a pinned application build
Independent parser evidence from same-application reopen
FreeCAD platform qualification or independent ACIS/AcDs semantic evidence
evidence.planUse: At the existing composed writer checkpoint, store application self-reopen and separately executed reference-CAD audit as distinct outcomes. If used, pin application/build and codec/kernel revisions, input/output hashes, target version, loss list, audit log, errors, repairs/deletions, and timeout.

evidence.topic: No eligibility boundary changed for CADKernel or Sea-DXF Core
observed: CADKernel's detailed format matrix continues to mark SAT/SAB unsupported; general format-count claims do not make it an ACIS route.
Sea-DXF Core's project statements reserve rights and say public visibility grants no permission to use or redistribute the source.
doesNotEstablish: An open-source peer eligibility change or any result applicable to libdxfrw
evidence.planUse: Retain CADKernel's ACIS exclusion and Sea-DXF Core's license-based exclusion; do not clone, build, run, copy, or derive implementation material from the excluded project.

nextActions: Continue local fast implementation slices without waiting for optional peer or consumer runtimes.
At the existing composed checkpoint only, distinguish downstream projection, same-application reopen, and independent native audit as separate evidence roles.
Keep LibreDWG and dxf-parser route lineage visible if Cadze is ever used for a named 2D consumer question.
Keep FreeCAD Linux/Windows qualification and independent ACIS/AcDs semantic evidence unchanged.

validation.notes: The receipt parsed with jq, the plan passed scoped git diff --check, and the receipt has no trailing whitespace. No local test, peer runtime, or native application was run.
